name: Chibuotu Amadi
description: Chibuotu Amadi is co-founder of Paycrest, where he works on open infrastructure for stablecoin–fiat payments. He has spent 7+ years building in crypto, including at ConsenSys and Gitcoin, with work spanning cross-chain systems and public-goods tooling. He now focuses on making the fiat edge of crypto more open, verifiable, and non-custodial.
